title: Exact global sections on a zero-dimensional finite-type scheme
statement:
Let u be a universe, k : Type u an algebraically closed field, C : Scheme.{u}, f : C ⟶ Spec k a separated, locally finite-type, quasi-compact morphism, and assume topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 0. Then the global sections functor on abelian sheaves in universe u+1 on the small etale site of C preserves finite colimits. Together with its existing finite-limit preservation, this says global sections are exact. The site, sheaves, and global sections are [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor]. No geometric points, sheaf F, or cohomology conclusion are assumed.

    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 0) :

proof.text:
By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-dim-zero-artinian], the finite-type
zero-dimensional scheme $C$ has finite discrete underlying space and every
point is closed. Let $i:C_{\mathrm{red}}\to C$ be the reduction. By
[lem-weil-pbc-reduction-universal-homeomorphism], $C_{\mathrm{red}}$ is reduced
and $i$ is a universal homeomorphism. Since $C_{\mathrm{red}}$ is a closed
subscheme of the finite-type $k$-scheme $C$, it is itself finite type over $k$.
Applying [lem-weil-pbc-closed-point-residue-field-base] to $C_{\mathrm{red}}$
identifies every residue field $\kappa_{C_{\mathrm{red}}}(c)$ with $k$ (equivalently,
$\mathcal O_{C_{\mathrm{red}},c}=\mathcal O_{C,c}/\sqrt{0}$ has the same
residue field). The singleton pieces of the finite discrete space
$C_{\mathrm{red}}$ are open and closed. Each such piece is affine by
[lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-affine]. Its coordinate ring is reduced
and has only one prime, hence is a field; the residue-field identification
makes that field $k$. Therefore each piece is $\operatorname{Spec}k$. By
[lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], the morphism from the coproduct of
these pieces to $C_{\mathrm{red}}$ induced by their inclusions is an
isomorphism: its restriction to each summand is the corresponding open
immersion, and the summands are pairwise disjoint and cover $C_{\mathrm{red}}$,
so it is bijective and a local isomorphism.

proof.text: Use [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance] to identify abelian etale sheaves on C with those on the reduction, compatibly with global sections. Sheaves on the finite coproduct of Spec k are families of sheaves on the summands. An algebraically closed field is strictly henselian. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-sections-stalk] to R = k and the identity geometric point: its natural germ isomorphism identifies sections on each summand with its geometric stalk. Restriction of global sections to the terminal etale object is a natural isomorphism. By [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact], this stalk functor preserves finite colimits, hence so do global sections on each summand. Thus global sections on the coproduct are the finite product of exact evaluations. Finite products in abelian groups are biproducts and commute with finite colimits. Transport finite-colimit preservation through the reduction equivalence. The empty scheme gives the constant zero functor and is included.
